versions.changelog:
patent-panorama-insights-tag v1.0.0

- Initial release for patent full-view tagging system recommendation (环节3).
- Generates a structured tagging taxonomy (≤40 mutually exclusive level-3 nodes) and key technical questions.
- Recommends ≥10 patent packages, each with at least 3 families and clear selection rationale based on six rules.
- Provides 20–30 tagged sample records and exports a ready-to-tag CSV for client SaaS tools.
- Ensures all outputs meet strict coverage, exclusivity, and sampling requirements.
- Includes optional HTML statistical report generation upon user confirmation.
